name: Component Diagram — Order Service
description: C4 Component Diagram (Level 3) breaks down the internal structure of the API Application container, focusing on Order Service with components: OrderController, OrderService, OrderRepository and related entities.
purpose: Describe the details of components inside a container and the relationships between them.
bestFor: Describing dependencies between controller, service, repository
Identifying interfaces and responsibilities of each component
useCases: Break down API Application into components
Identify: OrderController, OrderService, OrderRepository, Order Entity
requirements: REQ-001: OrderController receives HTTP requests and calls OrderService
REQ-002: OrderService contains business logic for processing orders
REQ-003: OrderRepository accesses database via JPA/Hibernate
REQ-004: OrderService calls PaymentClient to process payments
REQ-005: OrderService calls NotificationClient to send email/SMS
